subject.title: fix(providers): prevent idle timeouts during hidden reasoning

question: Should all valid OpenAI-compatible stream chunks, including hidden-reasoning-only chunks, reset the standard model idle watchdog for non-local providers?
rationale: The patch intentionally changes the generic definition of provider progress beyond the originally reported local endpoint, while current main already treats the reported local route differently; that contract choice requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Confirm generic chunk progress
options.body: Accept valid OpenAI-compatible chunks as watchdog activity, then require rebased proof through the standard non-local watchdog path.

options.title: Constrain the activity rule
options.body: Limit activity notifications to a narrower semantic signal if maintainers do not want empty or keepalive-style chunks to extend the watchdog.

recommendation.title: Confirm generic chunk progress
recommendation.body: Accept valid OpenAI-compatible chunks as watchdog activity, then require rebased proof through the standard non-local watchdog path.

likelyOwner.reason: They proposed the cross-provider activity contract and can clarify the intended behavior and validation boundary.
